words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens 71:9 as another ordered stage in Noah's report. It scopes the whole paired predicate, not only the first verb, so both public declaration and private confiding belong to one escalated method-beat after the public calling of 71:8. The repeated boundary formula {{ar:ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ}} ({{tr:thumma innī}}) keeps the same testimonial frame while the predicate expands from one public mode into an open-secret pair.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public and private outreach are presented as one later stage of effort after 71:8, not as a flat continuation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) as a sequence and discourse transition, and attachment evidence treats the following coordinated predicates as one emphatic report.

topics.reason: The echo rows fit the repeated local formula {{ar:ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ}} ({{tr:thumma innī}}) across 71:8 and 71:9 without changing the grammar of the current particle.

words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّىٓ}} ({{tr:innī}}) places the whole method-pair under emphatic first-person testimony before either action is named. The attached pronoun is the governed subject of the particle, then the same speaker reappears in the verb endings of {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}) and {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}). This makes the ayah a self-involving record of performed effort, not a neutral list of techniques. The variant release behind {{ar:إِنِّيَ}} ({{tr:inniya}}) can make the final pronoun audibly more open, but it preserves the same particle-plus-speaker syntax and the same agency.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence parses the first-person suffix as the governed subject of the emphatic particle and the following coordinated verbs as its predicate.

topics.reason: The boundary rows compare 71:8 and 71:9 at the repeated {{ar:إِنِّىٓ}} ({{tr:innī}}) frame; the comparison is structural rather than a new lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}) reports public disclosure as an accomplished first-person act. Its local frame gives a recipient phrase, {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), but no stated message-object, so the reader's attention falls on the mode of making the call public rather than on quoted content. The root field of {{ar:ع ل ن}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-n}}) is narrowed here to manifesting or making open: the Form IV shape makes Noah produce publicness, while the title/address branch is not the selected local sense. Beside {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}), the word becomes the open pole of a recognized public-secret polarity, with echoes at 14:38 and 2:274 and a tighter local contrast inside 71:9.

topics.headline: completed public action is aimed at recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees public disclosure as a completed act aimed at them, while the content of the announcement remains compressed.

topics.headline: Form IV makes openness produced, not incidental
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Noah actively makes the address public, while broader root branches are limited by the local Form IV verb.
topics.reason: V4 supports the manifesting/public-disclosure branch for {{ar:ع ل ن}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-n}}), while local grammar selects Form IV produced disclosure rather than becoming-public, seeking-publicness, or title/address usage.

topics.headline: publicness opens the local open-secret polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the public verb as the first pole of a communicative spectrum that the secret verb completes inside 71:9.
topics.reason: The local opposition between {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}) and {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) is licensed by the immediate syntax and by the public-secret branch contrast.

topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete references for hide-disclose or secret-public pairings, and the local ayah uses the same polarity without importing the action domain of those references.

topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks the local Form IV root as low-occurrence, and the phonetic row adds a secondary surface payoff compatible with the public-secret contrast.

words.prose: The first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) turns public disclosure into directed address. It governs {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) as the recipient of {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}), so the public act is not a broadcast into space or a bare mode-name. Its fused shape with the pronoun, {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), completes the first action unit before the conjunction and prepares the exact recipient-frame that will be rebuilt after the secret verb.

words.prose: The first {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the audience definite and continuous from 71:8. Because it is governed by {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), not directly by {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}), the people are recipients of the public declaration while the message content remains unstated. Its compact suffixal form completes {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), starts the repeated recipient refrain, and makes method rather than audience the variable when secrecy is added.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that adds the secret verb to the completed public unit. It coordinates opposed verbs without making the second an adversative correction or a strict internal time sequence, so openness and secrecy accumulate as complementary registers. Because the conjunction is prefixed to {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}), the private act enters as a joined coordinate, not as a detached afterthought.

topics.headline: coordination joins opposites without replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public and private methods are cumulative coordinates inside one testimony, not competing alternatives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) as coordinated with {{ar:أَعْلَنتُ}} ({{tr:aʿlantu}}), and QAC identifies the word as a conjunction.

words.prose: {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) completes the open-secret pair with a second accomplished first-person act. The verb receives its own {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), so private address is independently directed to the same people and not merely inherited by ellipsis. Its content-object remains unstated because {{ar:إِسْرَارًا}} ({{tr:isrārā}}) is a same-root manner intensifier, not the secret message itself. The broad {{ar:س ر ر}} ({{tr:s-r-r}}) family is narrowed to confidential communication: inwardness and hiddenness give the verb its private pressure, while joy, bed, navel, lunar, and other concrete branches do not govern the local sense. Against 20:62, where secret counsel is oppositional plotting, 71:9 makes secrecy part of persistent prophetic address. The adjacent echo into {{ar:إِسْرَارًا}} ({{tr:isrārā}}) then makes the second half self-intensifying in grammar and closure, with the repeated s-r-r and r-r texture making the private side audibly denser than a simple coordinate.

topics.headline: private address is completed and independently directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees secret address as an accomplished act toward the same audience, not as vague concealment or an inherited afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) a renewed recipient phrase and treats the final noun as a cognate accusative rather than a direct content-object.

topics.headline: broad hidden-root field narrows to confidential address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the method moves inward into confidential address, while the wider root family is not allowed to replace the local secrecy sense.
topics.reason: V4 preserves many {{ar:س ر ر}} ({{tr:s-r-r}}) branches, but the local opposition to public disclosure, renewed recipient phrase, and cognate accusative select confidential communication.

topics.headline: Form IV keeps secrecy as Noah's chosen mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees secrecy as Noah's deliberate delivery mode, not mutual whispering or a mere attempt to become concealed.
topics.reason: The surface is a first-person Form IV perfect, so reciprocal and seeking-concealment alternatives remain useful contrasts but do not control the local parse.

topics.headline: secret action completes the public-secret strategy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hidden register complete the communicative range begun by public calling in 71:8, while 20:62 shows a contrasting use of secrecy.
topics.reason: The local coordination and the concrete 20:62 contrast support secrecy as a communicative register here, not as oppositional plotting.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final noun as a cognate accusative, and the echo rows correctly read the adjacent same-root sequence as intensifying the second action.

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) renews recipient direction inside the secret half. Hidden address could sound inward or withheld, but {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) after {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) makes secrecy explicitly aimed at the same people. The repeated prepositional frame gives the private verb its own target and turns recipient direction into a repeated grammatical feature rather than a one-time attachment inherited from the public clause.

words.prose: The second {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) repeats the same known plural audience after the secret verb. It completes {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) before {{ar:إِسْرَارًا}} ({{tr:isrārā}}) arrives, so the people remain recipients of {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) and the final noun remains manner-intensity. The repetition blocks any drift toward a different private subgroup and makes the two clauses mirror each other: different verbs, same preposition, same audience.

words.prose: {{ar:إِسْرَارًۭا}} ({{tr:isrārā}}) is the ayah's closing cognate accusative. It does not introduce a new object of speech; it intensifies {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}) from inside the same Form IV root and supplies manner: secretly, with real secrecy as the quality of the act. Its indefinite accusative shape keeps the force qualitative and unpossessed, so the secrecy is the mode of Noah's action rather than something owned by the audience. The noun also keeps focus on active process rather than a passive concealed thing. As the last word, it tips the balanced public-secret pair toward an intensified secret landing: 2:274 offers a public-secret polarity in another domain, while 71:9 ends that polarity with the hidden side made grammatical, morphological, and audible through the same-stem noun, repeated r-r texture, and long final beat.

topics.headline: cognate accusative intensifies the private act

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:إِسْرَارًۭا}} ({{tr:isrārā}}) as the cognate accusative of {{ar:أَسْرَرْتُ}} ({{tr:asrartu}}), supporting internal object and adverbial manner force.

topics.headline: indefinite accusative makes secrecy qualitative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing secrecy as an unbounded quality of the act, not as a possessed or bounded secret belonging to the people.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an indefinite accusative verbal noun, and the contextual profile treats the local gerund as low occurrence with cognate-accusative behavior.

topics.headline: verbal noun selects process over concealed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names the performance and manner of secret communication, while passive or concrete hidden-thing branches are kept out of the local sense.
topics.reason: V4 preserves broad {{ar:س ر ر}} ({{tr:s-r-r}}) branches, but the local Form IV gerund after the matching verb selects process and manner rather than a passive concealed thing.

topics.headline: the final noun tips polarity into secret closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 71:9 land on intensified secrecy after public disclosure has opened the pair, with 2:274 showing the wider public-secret formula in another domain.
topics.reason: The word is final in 71:9, follows the public-secret verb pair, and the supplied 2:274 rows support the broader formula without controlling the local prophetic-address domain.

topics.headline: same-stem form and long closure make secrecy audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the hiddenness-root and long final beat reinforce the grammatical landing point.
topics.reason: The form rows match the same Form IV stem as the verb, and the phonetic rows are compatible with the final cognate accusative's closure role.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated أَعْلَنتُ and أَسْرَرْتُ ... إِسْرَارًا, with لَهُمْ repeated for the same audience.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first verb makes the address public, while the second carries it inward as confidential disclosure; the cognate accusative intensifies that inward mode. The pair closes both public and private refuges from the same appeal.

activation_trace.role: Manifesting something openly supplies the public channel and the movement from concealment into shared view.
Keeping something hidden inwardly supplies confidential access and makes the emphatic إِسْرَارًا an intensified private mode.

changed_reading.before: Noah used an open method and a secret method.
changed_reading.after: Noah saturated one audience across public visibility and confidential inward access, pursuing the private channel emphatically rather than adding it casually.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَعْلَنتُ is coordinated with the disputed declarative branch of أَسْرَرْتُ, followed by its emphatic verbal noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: A packet branch reports أَسْرَرْتُ as declaring or showing, although disputed. On that branch the two verbs need not be opposites: the second can restate and intensify the first, yielding cumulative proclamation.

activation_trace.role: Open manifestation supplies the undisputed first declaration and the semantic baseline for cumulative coordination.
The disputed sense of declaring what others call concealed permits the second clause to reinforce public disclosure instead of opposing it.

changed_reading.before: The verse necessarily contrasts public speech with secret speech.
changed_reading.after: Alongside the contrastive reading, it can carry an exploratory crescendo: I announced to them, indeed I declared it to them emphatically.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the preceding ayah already names a public, raised-voice call, the focus ayah's open verb is not the first public attempt. Its addition of emphatic secrecy after another open formulation marks escalation from a public campaign to exhaustive channel coverage.

activation_trace.role: Open manifestation repeats the outward mode inside the focus ayah and makes the subsequent private addition consequential.
Inward confidential disclosure supplies the newly added route after public address has already been tried.
Announcing and raising the voice supplies the already-active public channel against which 71:9 becomes an escalation.

structural_cues: 71:8 immediately precedes 71:9, and both begin with ثُمَّ إِنِّي.
71:8 already ends in the public-mode verbal noun جِهَارًا; 71:9 repeats openness and then adds the cognate accusative إِسْرَارًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an already-public call followed by open-plus-secret wording; I infer escalation from one channel to exhaustive routing. A live alternative is stylistic restatement without a strategic progression.

changed_reading.before: 71:9 independently lists two equivalent speaking styles.
changed_reading.after: 71:9 is the next escalation after an already-public appeal: public proclamation is renewed and confidential access is added so that no social register remains untried.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience has turned reception failure into an embodied defense: hearing is refused and the self is wrapped. Public announcement preserves open accountability, while secret address becomes an attempt to reach behind collective performance and into the guarded interpersonal interior.

activation_trace.role: Open manifestation supplies the accountable public route that remains active despite visible refusal.
Hidden inward disclosure supplies a route aimed beneath the audience's public defensive posture.
Listening and accepting what is heard supplies the reception channel that the audience deliberately blocks.
A covering laid over and concealing something supplies the active barrier around the hearer.
Clothing that can stand for the person supplies self-enclosure, making the refusal social and personal rather than merely acoustic.

structural_cues: 71:7 stacks fingers in ears, garments drawn over the self, persistence, and arrogance before 71:8-9 vary the call.
The repeated لَهُمْ in 71:9 keeps the resistant audience as the object of both modes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked listening and deliberate self-covering; I infer that the private mode is adaptive routing around those defenses. It may instead be only another item in a completeness formula.

changed_reading.before: Secret speech is simply quieter or less public speech.
changed_reading.after: Secret speech is a targeted attempt to cross a deliberately guarded reception boundary, while public speech keeps the claim visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first stated content after the focus ayah is an appeal for forgiveness, whose branch image covers wrongdoing and protects its bearer from the consequence. Confidential delivery can therefore be content-congruent: it offers return under protective cover rather than requiring public exposure as the price of hearing.

activation_trace.role: Private inward disclosure supplies a protected communicative setting rather than mere low volume.
Covering wrongdoing and preserving its bearer from the effect supplies the protective content that makes privacy ethically fitted to the appeal.

structural_cues: 71:10 begins فَقُلْتُ, presenting its imperative and divine attribute as the speech content immediately after 71:9.
The forgiveness root occurs twice in 71:10, as request and intensive attribute.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confidential disclosure followed by forgiveness as protective covering; I infer congruence between medium and message. The alternative is that delivery mode and forgiveness content are unrelated sequential details.

changed_reading.before: Privacy is only a tactical way to get the same proposition heard.
changed_reading.after: Privacy also performs the invitation's protective logic: a hearer may confront wrongdoing without first being exposed before the crowd.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's hidden-at-month-end moon branch meets a later luminous moon inside a sequence of successive states. Open and secret communication can then be modeled as phases of visibility through which one message moves, not only as fixed channels assigned to different audiences.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance supplies the visible phase of the communicative cycle.
The moon concealed at month's end supplies a temporary hidden phase rather than permanent absence.
Successive stages and states supply the temporal mechanism by which hidden and manifest modes alternate.
The moon and its sky-light supply the visible counterpart to the focus branch's concealed moon.

structural_cues: 71:14 names creation in stages, and 71:15-16 moves through layered heavens to moonlight and the solar lamp.
The focus ayah coordinates open and secret modes without assigning them to separate named subgroups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive states, a hidden-moon focus branch, and a luminous contextual moon; I infer phase alternation in communicative visibility. The live alternative is a simple public/private contrast with no cosmic analogy.

changed_reading.before: Open and secret are two static settings.
changed_reading.after: Open and secret may be successive visibility phases of one persistent address, like a message that remains operative through appearance and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later material images form a hidden-to-visible process: planting places growth below view, extraction brings a thing out of concealment, and insertion sends a thing into a route. The private address can be read as implanted inwardly and the public announcement as visible emergence, with both serving movement rather than rival messages.

activation_trace.role: Hidden inward placement supplies the below-view stage of the material analogy.
Manifestation supplies the visible emergence toward which inward placement may move.
Planting and causing growth supply the causal image of a message placed inwardly before visible result.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from inward reception to manifest outcome.
Inserting one thing into another supplies routed entry, turning private address into penetration of an interior path.

structural_cues: 71:17 uses a verb and cognate noun for human growth, echoing the focus ayah's verb-plus-cognate-noun emphasis.
71:18 repeats emergence with a verb and cognate noun, and 71:20 names traversable ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, planting, emergence, and routed insertion; I supply the arrow from private reception to public result. The alternative is that these later creation images do not describe the earlier communicative process.

changed_reading.before: Open and secret speech are parallel deliveries with no internal sequence.
changed_reading.after: Private speech can be the planted, inward stage and public announcement the emergent stage of one address moving through human routes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later conflict is maintained by allegiance and reproduced through offspring, while the closing prayer names parents, household entry, and a trusted believing community. Public speech addresses collective loyalty; confidential speech enters the household and trust relations where commitments are transmitted.

activation_trace.role: Open manifestation supplies intervention in the community's visible allegiance structure.
Confidential inward disclosure supplies access to the protected relationships beneath public affiliation.
Loyalty and succession supply the social chain that public and private address must interrupt.
Offspring from a lineage supplies intergenerational reproduction of the conflict.
Household and family supply the intimate social unit into which confidential address can enter.
Settled safety and trust of heart supply the relational condition under which private disclosure can become durable commitment.

structural_cues: 71:21 links following a leader with his wealth and offspring; 71:27 makes begetting a future social problem.
71:28 moves from parents to one entering the speaker's house and then to believing men and women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allegiance, offspring, household, and trust; I infer that the two speaking modes operate at public-network and household-transmission levels. The private mode could instead have no special household target.

changed_reading.before: Public versus private describes only audience size or volume.
changed_reading.after: The pair also spans social scales: visible collective allegiance and the trusted household relations through which allegiance survives into another generation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because title-address and choicest-core branches are form-distant from ordinary proclamation and secrecy. It remains anchored in both focus roots and explains their coordination as message architecture; downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَعْلَنتُ and أَسْرَرْتُ can activate an outwardly addressed form paired with an inward core.

activation_trace.role: Placing a title or address on a book supplies an outward frame directed to recipients.
The purest or choicest inner core supplies the concentrated substance entrusted beneath that outward frame.

changed_reading.before: The verse varies only the visibility of delivery.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also gives the address an outer heading and an inner core: publicly framed for all, privately entrusted in concentrated form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the marital branches are not the ordinary senses of the focus or context words. The activation remains anchored in the focus's hidden-relation branch and in later entry, house, and birth cues; downstream prose must present it only as an analogy for intimate household transmission, never as a claim that 71:9 has sexual content.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The private term أَسْرَرْتُ ... إِسْرَارًا has a branch of veiled marital relation that can be contained as a social-intimacy register.

activation_trace.role: A hidden marital or sexual relation supplies an unusually intimate relational domain for the private address.
Offspring from a lineage supplies the reproductive consequence that makes intimate relations socially consequential.
Marital consummation as inward entry supplies a branch-distant image of crossing into the intimate sphere.
The marriage-house supplies the household setting in which private commitment and generation meet.

changed_reading.before: Secret address is merely speech outside public hearing.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained social analogy, it reaches the intimate household bonds through which communal commitments are joined and reproduced.

strongest_changes: The immediately preceding public call makes 71:9 an escalation to exhaustive channel coverage, not an isolated two-item list.
The audience's blocked hearing and self-covering recast secrecy as adaptive access across a guarded reception boundary.
Forgiveness as protective covering makes confidential delivery congruent with the message rather than merely tactical.
Later allegiance, offspring, house, and trust cues expand the public-private pair across collective and household transmission.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory itself preserves both ordinary concealment and a disputed declarative sense for س ر ر, so contrastive and cumulative readings coexist. Context then activates strategic, protective, phased, generative, and household mechanisms without forcing a single resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أَسْرَرْ is contrastive concealment or the disputed declarative usage remains unresolved.
The phase, growth, and household models depend on explicit reader-supplied analogical arrows rather than direct syntactic predication.
Plural لَهُمْ does not establish whether private delivery was one-to-one, subgroup-based, or collective but nonpublic.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Disclosure covers both the social exterior and inward privacy.** **ع ل ن B001** supplies making open after concealment, while **س ر ر B001** supplies inward secrecy and confidential speech. Their coordinated opposition, with the secret root repeated as verb and cognate accusative, maps two distinct channels to the same recipients. The packet supplies both channels; the inferred arrow is that resistance cannot be attributed to either public pressure or lack of intimate access. The ayah becomes an exhaustive social diagnostic.

2. **Private address seeks the concealed core.** **س ر ر B005** supplies the purest or innermost core and **س ر ر B014** penetration of hidden matters. The previous ayah shows external covering, and 71:21–23 later reveals the interior social allegiance behind it. The abductive move is that confidential address is assigned the role of reaching and testing that core. The ayah therefore reads not only as lowered publicity but as an attempt at inward penetration.

3. **Secret address can carry the promise of ease.** **س ر ر B010** supplies joy, ease, and prosperity; immediately after the call to seek forgiveness, 71:11–12 promises water, wealth, children, gardens, and rivers. The packet supplies the private mode and the subsequent beneficent content; the inferred arrow is that private disclosure may have included or prepared an appeal through hoped-for flourishing. This reading coexists with concealment and does not collapse *isrāran* into “joy.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:21–23 revealed the hidden core that private address had failed to change: allegiance to wealthy leaders and preserved deities. Conversely, 71:11–12 made **س ر ر B010** newly visible by following disclosure with ease and flourishing.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Address at public and inward scales.** **Lexical evidence:** `ع ل ن B001` is making a matter manifest after concealment; `س ر ر B001` is keeping or communicating something inwardly and privately. **Structural cue:** the two verbs are coordinated and repeat the same beneficiary `لَهُمْ`, after public calling at 71:8. **Assigned role:** announcement addresses collective visibility, while confidential address reaches the private interior. **Abductive move:** I infer that resistance has both public and inward supports, requiring both scales of communication. **Reading change:** the pair is not contradictory volume-setting but comprehensive social access.

2. **Private speech as an affective opening.** **Lexical evidence:** `س ر ر B010` is joy and ease, activated dormantly beside the explicit secrecy branch `س ر ر B001`; 71:10-12 follow with forgiveness, rain, wealth, children, gardens, and rivers. **Structural cue:** concealed address immediately opens into a sequence of relief and provision. **Assigned role:** intimacy permits the warning to be coupled with reassurance rather than public exposure alone. **Abductive move:** I infer an affective function from the sequence; the packet does not specify the content assigned to each mode. **Reading change:** `أسررت` can carry hospitable, hope-bearing access as well as secrecy.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The relief sequence at 71:10-12 activated the affective ease of dormant `س ر ر B010`, while the successive human stages at 71:14 showed why inward address matters at more than one condition of development. Private speech thus became both reassurance and scale-sensitive access.

root_profile.summary: Anlam alanı saklama ve gizli konuşmadan tartışmalı açıklama karşıtlığına, örtülü evlilik ve cinsellik kullanımına, ay sonundaki görünmezliğe, arı öze, göbek ve deve hastalığına, oyukluğa, beden çizgilerine, sevince, yatağa, bitki uçlarına, yer mantarı örtüsüne, kavrayışlı kişiye ve yükselti üzerindeki kuma uzanır. Bu dallar yer yer gizlilik, içlik, yerleşme veya iyilik çağrışımları paylaşsa da çoğu bağımsız sözlük anlamlarıdır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
